description: This file defines the BIFF5 class, which maps BIFF5 color indices to their corresponding RGB color codes for the PhpSpreadsheet library's Xls reader.

classes.name: BIFF5
classes.description: Provides a color map for BIFF5 built-in colors used in the XLS file format.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Returns the RGB color code associated with a BIFF5 color index.
